# spyro profiles

Show every profile as spyro resolves it (spyro.toml plus ~/.ssh/config).

## Before you run it

Local only, no network, never prints passwords. Run this FIRST to learn each profile's host, user, `remote_path` (`(default)` means spyro.toml did not set it), sudo and forwarded ports. Never guess remote paths. `--json` for scripting.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro profiles`

```text
Usage: spyro profiles [OPTIONS]

  Show every profile as spyro resolves it (spyro.toml plus ~/.ssh/config).

  Local only: nothing connects to a server. Passwords are never shown.

Options:
  -p, --profile TEXT  Show only this profile
  --json              Output as JSON
  --help              Show this message and exit.
```
